derivation: For any rank-r orthogonal routing projector P, tr(P(G_center+G_common)) <= sum_top_r_eigenvalues(G_center)+tr(G_common), because G_common is positive semidefinite. Normalize by full antisymmetric energy. This is an upper bound, not an achieved all-U approximation.
scope: Includes entire unembedding and complete mixed-value source lift. Bounds linear routing-mode rank in coefficient norm; not total arithmetic-circuit complexity, physical importance or usefulness of weak circuits.
